ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.11 expands the validated V0.4.10 single-call JobGiver candidate optimization. Supported custom global GenClosest fallbacks with defined ThingRequests are now admitted because Vanilla still performs its normal regionwise search first and only consumes the custom set during the later global fallback. Candidate membership is unchanged. The same candidates are ordered by exact horizontal squared distance, with exact-distance ties retaining their original order, so Vanilla can establish the nearest valid best-distance earlier and avoid unnecessary reachability work. Calls with global search disabled or non-passable region types remain fail-closed. Reachability, WorkGiver validators, reservations, priorities and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. V0.4.8 bounded JobGiver tracing, V0.4.7/V0.4.6 hauling fast paths, bounded path validation and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
